```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['StichtagDatJahr'] = df['StichtagDatJahr'].astype(int)

pivot_df = df.pivot_table(values='AnzHunde', index='StichtagDatJahr', columns='KreisLang', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
for column in pivot_df.columns:
    plt.plot(pivot_df.index, pivot_df[column], marker='o', label=column)

plt.title('Total Number of Dogs per District Over the Years')
plt.xlabel
